name: manual_876a00
claim: Simulate a proposed fix against the failure it targets before offering it; a counter, or the digest of an event that already exists, cannot expose a clean snapshot rollback because the restored history is identical up to the snapshot.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: the digest-at-R_f fix suggested for orama-system#419 accepted the clean-rollback case in a hash-chained model; an independent side note said the same before the model did. Offering it unsimulated would have shipped a gap labelled as closed.
